title: French desktop About navigation opens Search
severity_rationale: The French desktop primary About link reaches the wrong section. This replay does not establish the availability of alternate navigation routes.
impact: A French desktop visitor selecting À propos is taken to Search and cannot reach the intended information through that primary link.
preconditions:
Fresh isolated browser context; Chromium 151.0.7922.34; locale en-GB; time zone UTC.
Viewport 1440 x 900 CSS pixels.
Synthetic local baseline on port 39175; no login.
The sole business input is tickets-reviewed.json; no application source or prior case evidence was read.
steps:
Open http://127.0.0.1:39175/fr/ at 1440 × 900.
Click the visible À propos link #main-about.
Inspect the actual URL and #page-heading.
expected: The destination is /fr/about, HTTP 200, html[lang]=fr, heading À propos d’Atlas Studio.
observed: #main-about href=/fr/search; actual destination http://127.0.0.1:39175/fr/search. Final URL http://127.0.0.1:39175/fr/search; HTTP 200; html[lang]=fr; heading Rechercher chez Atlas Studio.
correction_note: The observed desktop #main-about href points at the search route. Correcting its route binding to /fr/about is a hypothesis to verify in implementation; no source was inspected.
acceptance_criteria:
Clicking #main-about from /fr/ reaches /fr/about and the approved localized heading.
The English desktop primary navigation continues to reach /en/about.
The already working French mobile #mobile-about route remains /fr/about.
retest_steps:
Repeat the numbered reproduction for REPLAY-QA-001 against the corrected origin in a new campaign.
Execute the ticket's separate acceptance witness journeys; they were not part of this replay.

Read the destination URL, html[lang] and #page-heading.

title: French legacy redirect switches the visitor to English
severity_rationale: The French legacy entry redirects to an English document, losing the requested language.
impact: A visitor following the French legacy URL receives the English About page and loses the requested language.
preconditions:
Fresh isolated browser context; Chromium 151.0.7922.34; locale en-GB; time zone UTC.
Viewport 1440 x 900 CSS pixels.
Synthetic local baseline on port 39175; no login.
The sole business input is tickets-reviewed.json; no application source or prior case evidence was read.
steps:
Open http://127.0.0.1:39175/fr/legacy at 1440 × 900.
Capture the redirect status and Location.
Inspect the final URL, document language and heading.
expected: /fr/legacy returns HTTP 302 with Location /fr/about; the final page returns HTTP 200, html[lang]=fr and heading À propos d’Atlas Studio.
observed: Legacy response HTTP 302; Location /en/about. Final URL http://127.0.0.1:39175/en/about; HTTP 200; html[lang]=en; heading About Atlas Studio.
correction_note: The redirect Location is visibly bound to the English route. Preserve the incoming language when selecting the About target; this implementation hypothesis has not been source-verified.
acceptance_criteria:
French legacy returns HTTP 302 to /fr/about, followed by a 200 French About document.
English legacy still returns HTTP 302 to /en/about, followed by a 200 English About document.

Execute the ticket's separate acceptance witness journeys; they were not part of this replay.

Click #contact-submit once.
Read #name-error and #email-error.
expected: Visible messages are Saisissez votre nom. and Saisissez une adresse e-mail valide.; both fields have aria-invalid=true and confirmation stays hidden.
